features.summary: A source: the one source type every value position takes, and each kind of source a declared member is: a component's or a plugin's property, a method's result, a payload's or a body's field.
features.oracle: The spec itself, where the framework is the authority: D7.1 and D7.2's closed positions and sources, D3.13's conversion and gate 1's P8 forms; and ECMAScript's Number type, which holds no whole number past 9007199254740991 exactly.

promises.page: The resident record's note text, set from the OptionalText of the care panel's Raised, and the care panel, a ConformanceComponent whose Raise buttons raise Raised with or without its optional text.
promises.gesture: Click the care panel's Raise without optional text.
promises.outcome: The note text shows its empty state.
promises.opposite: Raised with the optional text Fall at 3am, the note text shows Fall at 3am.
promises.defect: The missing member stops the pipeline, so the note text keeps its earlier text, or reaches it as the text undefined.

promises.page: A refusal page whose step sets a ConformanceComponent's Amount from a response field its own JSON converter writes as text.
promises.outcome: The page is refused where the view renders with X7.10's message, naming the field and its own JSON converter.
promises.opposite: The same field with no converter of its own renders, and the component shows the amount the response holds.
promises.defect: The converter's text reaches the live member, so the component holds the text in place of its number.

promises.page: A bed register page whose step, when the document is ready, GETs the register and sets a ConformanceComponent's Records from its Beds, each a Record whose Day is a DateTime, in an app whose JSON options add a DateTime converter.
promises.outcome: The page is refused where the view renders with X7.10's message for a member at depth, naming the read register.Beds and the member Record.Day.
promises.opposite: Under the app's options without that converter the same page renders, and the component lists Bed 1 and Bed 2.
promises.defect: The converter's text is shaped as a date, which no date form reads, so each record reaches the component without its day and with no error.

promises.page: A refusal page whose step sets a ConformanceComponent's Amount, a decimal, from the literal 9007199254740993.
promises.outcome: The page is refused where the view renders with X7.13's message, naming the component's member and the value.
promises.opposite: The literal 9007199254740991 renders, and the component shows the amount 9007199254740991.
promises.defect: JavaScript reads the literal as 9007199254740992, so the page renders and the component shows another amount.

promises.page: An app whose JSON options write numbers as text; a Find the supply button that GETs the supply, whose body's VialCount is 5, and the dose scanner, the round's ConformanceComponent, whose Amount holds 1 and whose Add(amount) adds what it is passed to its Amount, which it shows.
promises.gesture: Click Find the supply, then click Add.
promises.outcome: The scanner shows the amount 6.
promises.opposite: A found supply whose vial count is 0 leaves the scanner's amount at 1.
promises.defect: The text 5 reaches the method, so the scanner shows 15.

promises.page: The resident record, whose note text shows the care panel's Raised payload's NullableText IfNull the care panel's Text, Morning round, and the care panel's two buttons that raise Raised with the nullable text Line occluded or with a null nullable text.
promises.gesture: Click the care panel's button that raises Raised with a null nullable text.
promises.outcome: The note text shows Morning round.
promises.opposite: Raised with Line occluded, the note text shows Line occluded and not the panel's text.
promises.defect: The null reaches the note text, so it shows nothing or the text null, or the panel's text is taken over a held nullable text.

promises.page: The resident record whose Log value button passes the care panel's Value IfNull the text No value to the panel's Log(text), which writes text and the text into its log, on a care panel whose Value holds null and one whose Value is Air in line.
promises.gesture: Click Log value on the care panel whose Value holds null.
promises.outcome: The panel's log reads text No value.
promises.opposite: On the care panel whose Value is Air in line, the log reads text Air in line.
promises.defect: The method receives undefined, so the log reads text undefined or keeps its earlier line.

promises.page: A resident page whose Check button runs When(weight IfNull 70 > 65) to show Heavy, else Light, over a resident whose weight holds null and one whose weight is 60.
promises.gesture: Click Check on the resident whose weight holds null.
promises.outcome: The badge shows Heavy.
promises.opposite: On the resident whose weight is 60, the badge shows Light: the held weight is compared, not the fallback.
promises.defect: The null weight is compared as null, so the badge shows Light, or the fallback replaces the held 60 and shows Heavy.

promises.page: The resident record whose Set target button sets the target, shown before its unit ml, from Choose on the order's restriction flag, 1000 when it holds and the care panel's Total() when it reads nothing; the care panel, the record's ConformanceComponent, answers Total() with its count, 850, and shows its calls, the count of its method calls.
promises.gesture: Click Set target on an order whose flag holds, then on an order whose flag reads nothing.
promises.outcome: The target shows 1000, then 850, and the panel's calls show 1.
promises.opposite: Set on the flagged order alone, the calls stay 0.
promises.defect: Both arms are read each time, so the calls show 2, or the flag that reads nothing takes the first arm and shows 1000 ml.

promises.page: The resident record whose Record button sets the care panel's NullableCount, shown in its nullable count line, from the intake field, a number input, widened with OrNull(), and that field can be cleared.
promises.gesture: Type 500 in the intake field and click Record.
promises.outcome: The care panel's nullable count line reads 500.
promises.opposite: With the field cleared, Record sets the panel's nullable count line to 0, the intake's start, since a blank input reads what the member binds as (D3.6).
promises.defect: The widened value is dropped or written as text, so the panel keeps its earlier nullable count or shows the text 500.

promises.page: A fluid balance page whose Check button runs When(intake.OrNull() > target) to show Over target, else Within target, with a target of 1000 ml that can be cleared.
promises.gesture: Type 1200 and click Check, then type 500 and click Check.
promises.outcome: The badge shows Over target, then Within target.
promises.opposite: On a fresh record, with an intake of 500 and the target cleared, Check shows Within target, since the cleared target reads its start, null, and no order holds against it; with the target then set to 400, Check shows Over target.
promises.defect: JavaScript's 500 > null holds, so the cleared target shows Over target.

promises.page: The resident record whose Take text button passes the care panel's Text widened to string? to the panel's TakeText(text), which shows the text it receives as its taken text, (null) for null, on a care panel whose text is Morning round and one whose text holds null.
promises.gesture: Click Take text on the care panel whose text is Morning round.
promises.outcome: The panel's taken text reads Morning round.
promises.opposite: On the care panel whose text holds null, the taken text reads (null).
promises.defect: The widened source writes nothing, so the taken text keeps its earlier text.

promises.page: A medication page whose dose badge shows a found chart's status, which the member's own JSON converter writes, IfNull the status a select on the page holds.
promises.outcome: The page is refused where the view renders with X7.11's message, naming the chart's status and its own converter.
promises.opposite: The same IfNull with the fallback DoseStatus.Given renders, and for a resident with no chart a When on it equal to Given shows the literal Given.
promises.defect: The two forms join, so the badge holds the converter's text on one arm and the select's text on the other, and a comparison with Given fails on one of them.

promises.page: A medication page whose dose badge shows Choose on a test between a found chart's status, which the member's own JSON converter writes, and the status a select on the page holds.
promises.outcome: The page is refused where the view renders with X7.11's message, naming the chart's status and its own converter.
promises.opposite: The same Choose with the literal arm DoseStatus.Given renders, and when the test holds a When on it equal to Given shows the literal Given.
promises.defect: The two forms join, so the badge holds the converter's text on one arm and the select's text on the other, and a comparison with Given fails on one of them.

promises.page: A medication page whose Check button runs When(chart status IfNull DoseStatus.Given equals DoseStatus.Given) to show Given, else Not given, where the status member is written by its own converter as text, where the chart is the body a Find the chart button GETs, over a resident with no chart found and one whose chart says Missed.
promises.gesture: Click Find the chart for the resident with no chart found, then click Check.
promises.outcome: The badge shows Given.
promises.opposite: On the resident whose chart says Missed, the badge shows Not given.
promises.defect: The fallback is written as the enum's number while the found status is the converter's text, so the comparison fails and the badge shows Not given.

promises.page: A medication page whose Check button runs When(Choose(test, DoseStatus.Given, chart status) equals DoseStatus.Given) to show Given, else Not given, beside a found chart, the body a Find the chart button GETs, whose status its own converter writes as Missed.
promises.gesture: Click Find the chart, tick the test box and click Check.
promises.outcome: The badge shows Given.
promises.opposite: With the box cleared, the badge shows Not given, the found chart's Missed.
promises.defect: The literal arm is written as the enum's number while the found status is the converter's text, so the comparison fails and the badge shows Not given.

promises.page: The round's duty board, whose Find the nurse button GETs the nurse on duty, whose body's Name holds null, and sets the duty line to the text joined from Nurse [, the nurse's name and ] on duty.
promises.outcome: The duty line reads Nurse [] on duty.
promises.opposite: A nurse on duty named Bea: the duty line reads Nurse [Bea] on duty.
promises.defect: A part that holds null is written as JavaScript's + writes it, so the line reads Nurse [null] on duty, or the joined text reads nothing and the line shows nothing.

promises.page: The round's dose board, whose Find the dose button GETs the trace dose, whose body's Grams is 0.00005, a double, and sets the dose line to the text joined from Dose, a space, the grams and a space with g.
promises.outcome: The dose line reads Dose 5E-05 g.
promises.opposite: A dose of 0.5 grams: the dose line reads Dose 0.5 g.
promises.defect: The join converts the number by JavaScript's own rules, so the line reads Dose 0.00005 g (Schema.tla:JoinedPartsAreTexts).

promises.page: A panel week page with a care panel, a ConformanceComponent, whose Load button GETs a week's plan, whose Care holds Mon | Sat | Sun of CareDays, an enum the app names as flags and its JSON writes by name, sets the panel's Days from it and shows the plan's resident, and whose Send care button GETs the care endpoint with r => r.Care set from the panel's Days and shows the endpoint's answer, the days it bound.
promises.gesture: Click Load, and once the plan's resident shows, click Send care.
promises.outcome: The URL holds Care=Mon%2C+Weekend and Care sent reads Mon, Weekend.
promises.opposite: At the address whose plan holds Mon alone, the URL holds Care=Mon and Care sent reads Mon.
promises.defect: The body's text enters the panel's Days, a member held as a number, so the request's split cannot read it and no request leaves (D9.13).

promises.page: A bed turnover page with a turnover panel, a ConformanceComponent, whose Load the beds button GETs a ward's beds, Records whose Stage is an enum the app's JSON writes by name and whose Wing its own JSON converter writes by its C# name, sets the panel's Records from them, and shows the count of the panel's records whose Stage equals Ready, of those whose Stage equals Waiting, and of those whose Wing equals South. The north ward's beds are Bed 1, ready, Bed 2, waiting, and Bed 3, closed.
promises.outcome: Ready beds reads 1.
promises.opposite: At the south ward's address, whose beds are waiting, ready and ready, Ready beds reads 2.
promises.defect: The walk maps no enum inside a record, so each record in the panel holds its stage as the body's text, no record's stage equals Ready, and Ready beds reads 0.

promises.page: A bed turnover page with a turnover panel, a ConformanceComponent, whose Load the beds button GETs a ward's beds, Records whose Stage is an enum the app's JSON writes by name and whose Wing its own JSON converter writes by its C# name, sets the panel's Records from them, and shows the count of the panel's records whose Stage equals Ready, of those whose Stage equals Waiting, and of those whose Wing equals South. The north ward's beds are in the South, North and South wings, and the app's JSON names every other enum in camel case.
promises.outcome: South wing beds reads 2 and Ready beds reads 1.
promises.opposite: At the south ward's address, whose beds are all in the North wing, South wing beds reads 0 and Ready beds reads 2.
promises.defect: The wing's rows are written from its type's writing under the app's options, south, so the South the member holds matches no row, each record reaches the panel without its wing, and South wing beds reads 0.

promises.page: A bed turnover page with a turnover panel, a ConformanceComponent, whose Load the beds button GETs a ward's beds, Records whose Stage is an enum the app's JSON writes by name and whose Wing its own JSON converter writes by its C# name, sets the panel's Records from them, and shows the count of the panel's records whose Stage equals Ready, of those whose Stage equals Waiting, and of those whose Wing equals South. At the east ward's address Bed 1 holds 99 as its stage, a number no value of the enum names, and Bed 2 is ready.
promises.outcome: Waiting beds reads 1: Bed 1's stage reads nothing, so its record reaches the panel without a stage and reads the stage a record starts at, Waiting (D3.3, D4.2).
promises.opposite: At the west ward's address, whose Bed 1 is closed, Waiting beds reads 0.
promises.defect: A held form no row lists is passed on, so the panel's record holds 99 and Waiting beds reads 0.

promises.page: A night panel page with a day panel, a ConformanceComponent started with the days Mon | Sat | Sun, and a night panel, a second one; a Copy the day panel's days button sets the night panel's Days from the day panel's and shows that it did, and a Send night care button GETs the care endpoint with r => r.Care set from the night panel's Days and shows the endpoint's answer.
promises.gesture: Click Copy the day panel's days, and once the page shows the days copied, click Send night care.
promises.outcome: The URL holds Care=Mon%2C+Weekend and Care sent reads Mon, Weekend.
promises.opposite: At the address whose day panel starts with Mon alone, the URL holds Care=Mon and Care sent reads Mon.
promises.defect: The rows of the app's form are written for a source a live object holds, so the number the day panel holds matches no row, the night panel's days read nothing, and the request sends neither Mon nor Weekend.

promises.page: A planned care page with a care panel, a ConformanceComponent, whose Load button GETs a plan whose Care holds Sat of CareDays, an enum the app names as flags and its JSON writes by name, sets the text of the Day planned line from it and the panel's Days from the same read, and whose Send care button GETs the care endpoint with r => r.Care set from the panel's Days and shows the endpoint's answer.
promises.outcome: Day planned reads sat, the name the app's JSON writes.
promises.opposite: The same read set into the panel's Days arrives as the live form holds it: Send care then sends Care=Sat and Care sent reads Sat.
promises.defect: The element's text is written through the mapping a live member takes, so Day planned reads 32.

promises.page: A shift handover on the resident record, rendered with the day carer Ada in a NativeTextBox. Send handover GETs the night roster, whose reply names Ben on call, and in that route POSTs a JSON body whose Carers, an IReadOnlyList<string?>, is pipeline.List<string?>([the day carer's Value, the reply's OnCall]); the endpoint records the handover and answers the carers it bound, in order, which the page writes into handover.
promises.outcome: handover reads Handover recorded: Ada, Ben.
promises.opposite: Send day handover, whose list holds the one source, reads Handover recorded: Ada.
promises.defect: The door writes its first item alone, so handover reads Handover recorded: Ada; for the opposite, a list of one is written as its item, so the endpoint binds no list and records no handover.

promises.page: The shift handover of X7.21, rendered with the day carer Ada, in a world whose night roster names nobody on call, so the roster answers null and the reply's OnCall reads nothing. Send handover POSTs Carers, an IReadOnlyList<string?>, as pipeline.List<string?>([the day carer's Value, the reply's OnCall]); the endpoint binds the list as System.Text.Json binds it, records the handover and answers each carer it bound in order, a null one written as no carer on call, which the page writes into handover.
promises.outcome: handover reads Handover recorded: Ada, no carer on call.
promises.opposite: With Ben seeded on the night roster, Send handover reads Handover recorded: Ada, Ben.
promises.defect: The door drops an item that reads nothing, so handover reads Handover recorded: Ada, and a door that stops on it sends nothing, so handover reads No handover sent.; for the opposite, a door that holds the reply's item as null reads Handover recorded: Ada, no carer on call.

verdicts.reason: Its constructor is on the public surface although no subclass outside the assembly compiles, since the read a subclass overrides is internal; the sources are D7.2's closed set, each made by its own door.

features.summary: The page's own URL as a source: a member of the page's class read from the path's placeholder or the query, as the action that rendered the page bound it.
features.oracle: The two hosts' model binders, which bind a query key ignoring case (probe:core-query-key-case, probe:mvc5-query-key-case), as N10.7 states the page's URL reads; and the WHATWG URL Standard's URLSearchParams, whose get matches a key by case (probe:js-query-get-case).

defects.defect: A page opened at ?TAB=medications reads nothing for its Tab member, where both hosts bind the key ignoring case (N10.7).

A query member whose key is absent or whose text does not convert to its type reads something other than its start: ?beds=abc for an int Beds initialized to 2 reads nothing or NaN, where the action bound 2 (N10.7).
A placeholder member is read from the query in place of the path, so a page whose template is /Wards/{Ward}, opened at /Wards/East?ward=West, reads West or nothing for Ward (N10.7).
A read of a member the page's class does not declare, or of the URL by a string that names a key, does not compile: Read takes a member lambda over the page's class, N10.7.

promises.page: A chart page typed by ChartPage, whose Tab member starts as vitals, and whose on-load sets the open tab's text from the page's URL's Tab.
promises.outcome: The open tab reads medications.
promises.opposite: Opened with no tab key, the open tab reads vitals.
promises.defect: The key is matched by case, so the open tab reads vitals or nothing.

promises.page: A ward page typed by WardPage, whose int Beds member starts as 2, and whose on-load sets the beds text from the page's URL's Beds.
promises.gesture: Open the page at ?beds=abc, then at ?beds=7.
promises.outcome: The beds text reads 2 after the first, and 7 after the second.
promises.opposite: Opened with no beds key, the beds text reads 2.
promises.defect: The unconvertible text reads nothing or NaN, so the beds text is empty or shows NaN after the first.

promises.page: A ward page whose URL template is /Wards/{Ward}, and whose on-load sets the ward text from the page's URL, read with that template, at its Ward.
promises.outcome: The ward text reads East.
promises.opposite: Read without the template, the ward text reads West, from the query.
promises.defect: The placeholder is read from the query, so the ward text reads West, or from nowhere, so it is empty.

verdicts.reason: A string names the query key, which ALIS009 refuses, and the browser's URLSearchParams.get matches it by case where both hosts bind it ignoring case; the page's URL is typed by the page's class and read by a member lambda.
